findings.issue: STR-003 rewrite says the package src/ root contains only the public provider, feature modules, and Laravel/. D35, glossary (Testing-модуль in src/), and research/04-architecture.md §3 also place CoreX\<Pkg>\Testing\ at that root. The feature-modules gate built from this sentence rejects that directory.
findings.fix: Add Testing/ to the allowed src/ root set in the STR-003 sentence, in the same terms as D35.

findings.issue: NEW-1 says the kernel owns CoreX\ only through the closed module list. D29 and glossary N3 also give the kernel the root symbol CoreX\CoreServiceProvider and the reserved segment CoreX\Testing. research/04-architecture.md §3 states both. An ownership gate from NEW-1 rejects them.
findings.fix: State the kernel ownership set as glossary §Kernel modules plus §Root symbols plus §Reserved segments.

findings.issue: core-zones.md §1 allows non-foundation kernel modules to depend only on Context, Data, Errors, Time, Config, and Database, with no exception recorded. D29 and glossary F5 keep Departments because Settings/Features depend on it; glossary F6 keeps Features woven into Settings. Both edges are outside that foundation set.
findings.fix: Record those inter-module edges as named exceptions in the §1 rule (Settings/Features→Departments, Features→Settings).

findings.issue: table-ownership.md §1 rewrite says the table prefix defines the owning package. DATA-001 is keep: ownership is declared per table, not by prefix. D20 keeps ownership on DATA-*.
findings.fix: Rewrite §1 so a prefix is unique to one owner after the shared sys_ split, while DATA-001 remains the declaration rule.

findings.issue: §2 states 1756 edges as keep 1648, remove 94, move 29, invert 13. Those four figures sum to 1784. dependency-edges.tsv has keep 1620, remove 94, move 29, invert 13 (1620+94+29+13=1756).

constitution.md anti-goals NON-003 and NON-008 stay in force and have no delta row. NON-003 forbids extracting Money and Views into Composer packages; D27 moves Money to corex-intl and D28 moves SavedViews to corex-panels. NON-008 forbids an operations-tools package; D12/D31 create corex-tools.
findings.fix: Add constitution NEW-* rows (phase P02, package-map gate) that narrow NON-003 to the modules that stay in the kernel and allow corex-tools while leaving HTTP delivery in corex-operations.

findings.issue: CFG-002 and config-policy.md §3 allow config() only in register() of the public provider. D08 allows config() and env() in service providers and configuration commands, and forbids them on the runtime path.
findings.fix: Match D08: config() and env() only in service providers and configuration commands, never on the runtime path.

findings.issue: API-007 is keep (public-symbol removal only in a major and only after announced deprecation). api-policy.md §5 is keep (operation-contract/1 stays frozen; baseline is not updated). D01 removes compatibility and deprecated bridges until 1.0.0-rc.1. api-policy.md §4 was rewritten for that window; these two rows were not.
findings.fix: Rewrite API-007 and api-policy.md §5 so the deprecation requirement and the frozen snapshot start at 1.0.0-rc.1, with P02–P08 regenerating the baseline under D01.

findings.issue: core-zones §1 says kernel modules depend on each other only via Settings→Departments, Features→Settings, Features→Departments, Database→Audit. D29 plus namespace-map keep further edges: Messaging→Observability (TraceContextBridge→OperationContext), Observability→Audit (OperationContext→ActorType → CoreX\Audit\Enums), Modules→Settings/Audit/Features (NullSettingDefaultsProvider, CurrentActor, AuditObserver, FeatureFlags → CoreX\Features\Contracts), and Settings/Features/Departments/Modules→Messaging (SettingChanged, FeatureFlagToggled, DepartmentMoved, Modules\Events extend DomainEvent → CoreX\Messaging\Events).
findings.fix: Add those arrows to the §1 exception list (and to the §3 R-Z rewrite) so KernelModuleTest matches D29.
